title: Azimuth linkage manifest
description: The language-neutral artifact each codebase emits: the realizes tags on production code and the covers tags on tests, keyed by the (spec, req, scenario) triple. Derived intent — scenario form (scope/quantification), invariant declarations, and exposes/upholds live in the spec, never here.

realizes.description: Production-code sites on a scenario's path. No form: form is how a test checks, not a property of code.

covers.description: Tests that verify a scenario, each at a declared form.

untraced_tests.description: The dual of an uncovered scenario: test methods in a class that participates in tracing (has ≥1 covers) yet declare no scenario and are not explicitly opted out. Optional and back-compatible — an absent array means the emitter found none (or does not emit them).

site.description: The enclosing symbol the tag sits on — the code or test site.

file.description: Source path of the site, relative to the emitting codebase root.

lang.description: Emitting language (e.g. csharp, typescript, rust) — for the polyglot fan-out view.

scope.description: How much of the real system the check runs against.

quantification.description: One case (example, ∃) vs a property over all inputs/states (invariant, ∀).

oracle.description: How the expected result was obtained. Descriptive only — never gated.

site.description: The test method site (e.g. Type.Method) — the test that declares no scenario.

file.description: Source path of the test, relative to the emitting codebase root.
